notes: Owner-authored study-guide prose for the E1-S3 listening review. Committed rather than composed per run so a retake reviews the same words and only the audio differs. Chosen to exercise what the five review criteria ask about: acronyms and initialisms for pronunciation, digits and units for normalization, a question and an em-dash for intonation and pacing, and a long clause for breath placement.

lines.text: A vector database stores embeddings and retrieves them by similarity rather than by exact match.
The HTTP API returns 404 when the record is absent and 409 when two writers disagree.
What happens when the cache key changes but the audio behind it does not?
Write-ahead logging makes a crash recoverable: the log is flushed before the page it describes.
SQL indexes speed up reads and slow down writes, so the right number of them is rarely zero and rarely ten.
A checksum proves that bytes did not change; it proves nothing at all about whether they were ever correct.
